description: We're a student team interested in AI/ML, Python, and space technology. We're looking for members with skills in machine learning, data science, GIS, web development, or UI/UX who are interested in working on a NASA Space Apps project.
summary:
. The Core Challenge

NASA’s Terra MODIS has provided continuous global Earth observations for over two decades but is nearing decommissioning. Its operational successor, the VIIRS series (on Suomi-NPP, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21), ensures ongoing planetary monitoring.

However, because MODIS and VIIRS observe Earth with different spectral bandpasses, overpass times, and spatial resolutions (MODIS: 1 km / 500 m vs. VIIRS: 375 m), raw observations exhibit systematic discrepancies. The goal of this project is to harmonize VIIRS and MODIS measurements to preserve seamless, climate-grade data continuity without interruption.

2. What Was Built & Prove
